lines.text: [Adelard and Rowland are preparing for their daily training in the sparring grounds.]

lines.speaker: rowland
lines.text: Come on, Adelard! How long does it take to put on your armor?

lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: A wise general once told me 'A good soldier takes care of his equipment'.  I'm just trying to be safe, that's all.

lines.speaker: rowland
lines.text: Adelard, the training dummy isn't going to hurt you.  You've always been too cautious.

lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: Yeah, well, one day, when I still have both my arms and you're missing one, maybe you'll feel differently.  I'm ready now, let's get out there!
